title: EU Refund Policy
content: The refund policy for EU customers is 30 days from purchase date. Full refund available for eligible orders.

title: API Credential Rotation
content: To rotate API credentials: generate new key in the admin dashboard, update your clients, then revoke the old key.

title: API Error Codes
content: Error code SB-4021 indicates rate limiting. Retry the request after the Retry-After header expires.
